review_description: We bought 2 x 5kw system. Ergon energy has been down checking out the solar installation, our solar system does not meet the standards. They do not have Sealable neutral links or a building isolator switch installed. There has been only 1 form 2 submitted, there needs to be 2 form 2 submitted. Our solar has been disconnected as the 2 faults above need rectifying. Solar system was installed 2 years ago and still not complete
